phase.name: Lighter week
phase.rule: Two sets per lift at last week's weights, easy rides only plus a short 4×4. Let the body catch up.

Monday.title: Easy ride
how: Then 30 min steady: you could hold a conversation in full sentences. If you can't, slow down.
Monday.why: Easy riding builds the heart's base and burns fat without eating into your lifting. Most of your cardio should feel this easy.
Monday.safety: 6:00 is still dark until about 6:40: front and rear lights on.

Tuesday.title: Lift A · full body
Tuesday.summary: Squat · press · pull-up · Romanian deadlift · split squat · ab wheel · carry

warmup.name: Backward walk
warmup.cue: Small steps, stay on the balls of your feet, let the front of the thighs work.
warmup.home: Hallway, driveway or a quiet sidewalk.
warmup.gym: Treadmill walking backward on low speed, or a backward sled drag.

warmup.name: Tibialis raise
warmup.cue: Back against a wall, heels forward, lift your toes toward your shins and lower slowly.

warmup.name: Knee-over-toe split squat
warmup.cue: Long split stance, front knee travels past the toes, back knee comes close to the floor. Hold the pull-up bar or a wall for balance.
warmup.home: Bodyweight, holding a door frame or the pull-up bar.
warmup.gym: Bodyweight, hold a rack for balance.

warmup.name: Patrick step
warmup.cue: Stand on a low step, slowly lower the other heel to the floor by bending the standing knee forward over the toes.
warmup.home: Bottom stair or a sturdy book stack.
warmup.gym: Aerobic step or a low plate stack.

warmup.name: Couch stretch
warmup.cue: Back knee on a cushion against the wall or couch, squeeze the glute, stay tall.
warmup.home: Against the couch or a wall.

warmup.name: Dead hang
warmup.cue: Hang from the pull-up bar, shoulders relaxed, breathe slowly.

lifts.name: Squat
lifts.cue: Sit down between your hips, whole foot on the floor, chest up, stand up smoothly.
lifts.home: Goblet squat holding one heavy dumbbell or kettlebell at your chest.
lifts.gym: Barbell back squat in a rack with safeties, 6–8 reps.

lifts.name: Press
lifts.cue: Shoulder blades pulled back, lower slowly, press up without bouncing.
lifts.home: Dumbbell floor press, lying on the floor, knees bent.
lifts.gym: Dumbbell bench press on a flat bench.

lifts.name: Pull-up
lifts.cue: Start from a full hang, pull your chest toward the bar, lower slowly. If you get fewer than 5, do slow 5-second lowerings instead.

lifts.name: Romanian deadlift
lifts.cue: Soft knees, push your hips back, bar slides down the thighs until the hamstrings stretch, stand up tall.

lifts.name: Bulgarian split squat
lifts.cue: Back foot on the chair seat, front knee may travel over the toes, lower under control.
lifts.home: Back foot on the chair, dumbbells in hands when bodyweight gets easy.
lifts.gym: Back foot on a bench, dumbbells.

lifts.name: Ab wheel rollout
lifts.cue: From your knees, ribs down, roll out only as far as you can keep your lower back from sagging.

lifts.name: Farmer carry
lifts.cue: Heavy weight in each hand, walk tall, short quick steps.
lifts.gym: Heavy dumbbells or a trap bar.

cooldown.name: Slow breathing
cooldown.cue: Lie down, breathe out longer than you breathe in.

cooldown.name: Deep squat hold
cooldown.cue: Hold the pull-up bar or a door frame, sink into the bottom of a squat, heels down if you can.

Wednesday.title: Easy ride
how: Then 30 min steady: you could hold a conversation in full sentences. If you can't, slow down.
Wednesday.why: Easy riding builds the heart's base and burns fat without eating into your lifting. Most of your cardio should feel this easy.
Wednesday.safety: 6:00 is still dark until about 6:40: front and rear lights on.

Thursday.title: Lift B · full body
Thursday.summary: Deadlift · overhead press · row · Nordic curl · arms · knee raise · side plank · carry

warmup.name: Backward walk
warmup.cue: Small steps, stay on the balls of your feet, let the front of the thighs work.
warmup.home: Hallway, driveway or a quiet sidewalk.
warmup.gym: Treadmill walking backward on low speed, or a backward sled drag.

warmup.name: Tibialis raise
warmup.cue: Back against a wall, heels forward, lift your toes toward your shins and lower slowly.

warmup.name: Knee-over-toe split squat
warmup.cue: Long split stance, front knee travels past the toes, back knee comes close to the floor. Hold the pull-up bar or a wall for balance.
warmup.home: Bodyweight, holding a door frame or the pull-up bar.
warmup.gym: Bodyweight, hold a rack for balance.

warmup.name: Patrick step
warmup.cue: Stand on a low step, slowly lower the other heel to the floor by bending the standing knee forward over the toes.
warmup.home: Bottom stair or a sturdy book stack.
warmup.gym: Aerobic step or a low plate stack.

warmup.name: Couch stretch
warmup.cue: Back knee on a cushion against the wall or couch, squeeze the glute, stay tall.
warmup.home: Against the couch or a wall.

warmup.name: Dead hang
warmup.cue: Hang from the pull-up bar, shoulders relaxed, breathe slowly.

lifts.name: Deadlift
lifts.cue: Bar over the middle of your foot, flat back, push the floor away, stand tall, lower with control.

lifts.name: Overhead press
lifts.cue: Ribs down, press straight up, head through at the top.
lifts.home: Seated dumbbell press, back against the chair.
lifts.gym: Standing dumbbell or barbell overhead press.

lifts.name: Row
lifts.cue: Flat back, pull the elbows toward your hips, pause, lower slowly.
lifts.home: Bent-over barbell row, or one-arm dumbbell row with a hand on the chair.

lifts.name: Nordic curl
lifts.cue: Kneel on a cushion with your heels anchored, lower your body forward as slowly as you can, catch yourself with your hands, push back up.
lifts.home: Heels hooked under the bed frame or a heavy couch.
lifts.gym: Nordic bench, or lying leg curl for 8–12.

lifts.name: Curl and triceps
lifts.cue: Do one set of curls, then one set of overhead triceps extensions, then rest.
lifts.home: Dumbbell curls, then an overhead dumbbell extension.
lifts.gym: Cable or dumbbell curls, then cable overhead extension.

lifts.name: Hanging knee raise
lifts.cue: Hang from the bar, curl your knees toward your chest, lower slowly, no swinging.

lifts.name: Side plank
lifts.cue: Elbow under the shoulder, body in a straight line, breathe.

lifts.name: Suitcase carry
lifts.cue: One heavy weight in one hand, stay perfectly upright.

cooldown.name: Slow breathing
cooldown.cue: Lie down, breathe out longer than you breathe in.

cooldown.name: Deep squat hold
cooldown.cue: Hold the pull-up bar or a door frame, sink into the bottom of a squat, heels down if you can.

Friday.title: Norwegian 4×4
Friday.summary: 3 rounds of 4 min hard, 3 min easy.
how: 10 min warm-up, building from easy to moderate.
3 rounds: 4 min hard at 8–9 out of 10 (only a few words at a time), then 3 min easy spinning.
Friday.why: Once a week, this is the best-studied way to raise heart fitness (VO2 max), one of the strongest markers of long life.
Friday.safety: Pick a quiet stretch of road with no stop lights for the hard rounds. Lights on in the dark.

Saturday.title: Rest or mobility
Saturday.summary: Optional 15 min mobility and a walk in the morning light. Rest is fine too.
how: Then a 20–30 min walk outside, ideally in early sunlight.
Saturday.why: Moving every joint through its full range keeps it that way. Morning light helps sleep and energy.
Saturday.source: JR Stretch · CaliMove · Movement by David · Huberman

swap.title: Bad-weather swap: kettlebell circuit
how: 5 rounds, 1 min rest between rounds (about 25 min):
swap.note: Keep it moderate, about 6–7 out of 10, so you're fresh for the lifting days.

daily: Get outside light within an hour of waking, 5–10 min (more if cloudy).
Drink a glass of water before you train.
